einzeiler: A collection of true terrifying personal horror stories and close encounters.
kurzfassung: This episode presents a collection of unsettling personal accounts and close encounters shared by listeners. The stories feature disturbing incidents involving strangers, landlords, and unexpected stalkers. Each narrative explores real-life situations where individuals faced frightening and potentially dangerous threats.
stichpunkte: An unsettling encounter with a stranger at a party
A strange experience involving a weird landlord
A frightening incident with a neighbor outside a bedroom window at night
An almost abduction attempt from a front yard
A chilling encounter with a peeping tom wielding a knife
A terrifying experience in a quiet apartment where the author feared making noise
